extensions.notes: Implement the owner-scoped PNG download. Use sessionPrincipal(request.request) and publicOrigin() from @jeeves/rest-server; never read process.env.PUBLIC_ORIGIN. Read the QR from the generated qr descriptor's physical table by id and its owner_id column, returning 404 if it is absent or another owner's. Encode publicOrigin() + '/q/' + id as a 512x512 PNG with margin 4 and error-correction level M using the qrcode dependency already in package.json. Never encode destination. Set Content-Type: image/png and a Content-Disposition attachment header. Use deterministic encoder options (no timestamp or random metadata) so the bytes stay identical after destination edits and restarts. Do not generate the QR in the browser.

200.description: PNG QR code containing the stable public redirect URL

extensions.notes: Implement the public redirect. Query the current destination by id; if it is missing, return 404 and insert nothing. In one transaction (withTransaction from @jeeves/postgres-runtime), insert one scan row for the qr and commit, then return 302 with the destination in Location and Cache-Control: no-store. Every request counts, including repeated requests from the same client. Do not follow or cache the destination. Use the generated qr and scan descriptors for the physical table and column names, and parameterized SQL. Public access means no session lookup. Fastify also sends HEAD requests to this GET handler; do not insert a scan for HEAD. Do not expose fixture or clock controls.

Implement the owner-scoped activity query. Use sessionPrincipal(request.request); check the QR belongs to the authenticated principal and return 404 for an absent or another owner's id. Require from and to as inclusive UTC dates. A range is valid when to >= from and (to - from) is at most 365 days, i.e. at most 366 dates inclusive; reject anything else with 400. Return {total, days:[{date,count}]}; include every UTC day in the range, including zero-count days. Aggregate scan rows by UTC day using the generated qr/scan descriptors and parameterized SQL. Do not expose fixture or clock controls.

200.description: Activity over the requested UTC date range

extensions.notes: Read only the session owner QR. Return newest saved revisions, sorted by savedAt and id descending, at most 25 rows. Cursor must belong to this QR; reject another QR cursor without exposing it. Canonical URL is the earliest saved revision URL, or publicOrigin() plus /q/ plus the QR id before its first save. Never derive the canonical URL from destination or request headers.

200.description: Owned QR Studio and bounded revision history

extensions.notes: Authorize the owner before rendering. Strictly parse settings with @jeeves/qr-artwork@0.1.0, select the server-established canonical URL and render PNG. Return the exact bytes in a bounded base64 artifact envelope with hash and check evidence. Preview creates no revision. No uploads, browser QR rendering or client-selected identity/origin/renderer.

200.description: Server-rendered PNG preview and validation evidence

extensions.notes: Authorize the owned QR in a database transaction. Strictly normalize settings; use requestId as revision UUID. Render PNG and SVG with the pinned 0.1.0 renderer; store their hashes, canonical URL and configuration. Same requestId for the same owned QR and normalized configuration returns its original revision. Conflicting reuse returns generic 409; do not disclose another owner. No update/delete operation. Preserve the first revision canonical URL for subsequent revisions; retain old renderer versions when upgrading.

200.description: Same request identity and normalized settings already saved

extensions.notes: Scope both QR and revision to the session owner. Render only the saved canonical URL, settings and pinned renderer version; verify against the saved SHA-256 before returning base64 bytes. Fail if the renderer/version/hash cannot be honored. Export never changes the revision, destination or legacy /image endpoint. The frontend downloads exactly these bytes and media type; it does not reconstruct geometry.

200.description: Exact saved artifact bytes in a typed envelope

extensions.notes: Use @jeeves/analytics/postgres ownedEventCounter with generated qr and scan descriptors, timestamp occurredAt, label title and the authenticated sessionPrincipal. Validate UTC range with at most 90 inclusive days. Return consistent owner-scoped total scans, total/active QR resources, zero-filled daily counts and top ten. Counts are stored redirect events, not visitors. Never use a request-supplied owner or arbitrary SQL. No-store. Existing per-QR activity and all identities remain unchanged.

200.description: Owned QR scan events in the inclusive UTC range
